items.title: Honda To Launch New Sub 4m SUV and Mid Size SUV By 2028 in India – CEO

items.title: Honda resets global strategy, to launch 15 hybrid models by 2030
items.summary: The company also plans to introduce brand-new India-centric models from 2028 with a focus on sub-four-metre and mid-size SUVs for the local market.

items.title: Kia India launches BaaS financing model for Carens Clavis EV
items.summary: The company said ownership plans for the Carens Clavis EV will start at ₹51,520, while battery usage charges will begin at ₹3.3 per kilometre.

items.title: Tata Motors launches Altroz iCNG AMT at ₹8.69 lakh
items.summary: The launch expands the Altroz’s multi-powertrain portfolio by combining CNG efficiency with the convenience of an automated manual transmission.

items.title: Skoda Auto India unveils upgraded Kodiaq range with Lounge variant, ADAS upgrades
items.summary: The Kodiaq Sportline gets a key upgrade for 2026 with the addition of a full suite of advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), including adaptive cruise control, lane assist, blind spot detection, rear traffic alert and exit warning.
